mission_timeout.details: Mission-level timeout implemented via asyncio.wait_for. 2s timeout on 10s task completes in ~2027ms with TIMEOUT state.

resource_idempotency.details: complete_mission is idempotent - multiple calls never produce negative counters. Uses max(0, counter-1).

resource_accounting.details: Concurrent quota enforcement works: 3/5 missions created, 10/15 tasks created. Release allows retry. No negative counters.
